timeSyncDesc: Calibrate local clock drift via network time
siteDescription: Full Clock — A clean, full-screen clock with no ads. Fully customizable colors, fonts, and display modes. Features time sync calibration for accurate timekeeping.
helpQA1A:
This app calibrates time by sending parallel requests to three time APIs with a 1.5s timeout:
• api.shijian.online
• worldtimeapi.org
• timeapi.io

For each API, the app records the local time before sending (T1) and after receiving the response (T4), then calculates:
• offset = server timestamp − (T1+T4)/2
• error margin = (T4−T1)/2 (half the round-trip time, RTT)

Results from all successful APIs are combined using inverse-variance weighted averaging for optimal precision.

The title bar shows real-time sync status: ✓ synced, ⚠ failed, spinning while calibrating.
Three modes are available: Auto (sync on page load), Manual (sync on demand), or Off.
helpQA2Q: What do the different seconds display modes mean?
helpQA2A:
Three modes:
• Off — hides seconds.
• Digital — shows :34 as a counter.
• Background Bar — progress bar filling as the minute passes (default). Positions: Fullscreen (default, full width), Top, Bottom.
helpQA3A: Open Settings → Colors. Pick from 6 presets (Classic Green, Midnight Blue, High Contrast, Warm Sunset, Matrix, Slate) or customize background, text, and progress bar colors individually via color pickers. Progress bar opacity is also adjustable. All changes preview in real time.
helpQA4A:
Open Settings → Colors, find the Font dropdown. Available options:

Monospace (recommended for clock display):
• Cascadia Code — Microsoft’s modern monospace
• Fira Code — Popular coding font with ligatures
• JetBrains Mono — Purpose-built for screens
• Consolas — Classic Windows coding font
• Courier New — Universal fallback
• monospace — System default

Chinese (for title bar dates):
• 等线, 微软雅黑, 宋体, 黑体, 楷体

Monospace fonts ensure stable digit widths — the time won’t jump as numbers change. Chinese characters fall back to your system’s CJK font automatically. Try different options in the preview panel.
helpQA5A:
Yes. Full Clock is a PWA. After the first visit, the Service Worker caches all resources (cache-first strategy). Subsequent loads work fully offline. You can also install it to your home screen for a native-like experience.

Time calibration requires a network connection; everything else works offline.
helpQA6Q: How do I keep the screen on?
helpQA6A:
Open Settings → Utilities, toggle “Keep screen on”. This uses the Screen Wake Lock API to prevent your screen from dimming or locking.

Limitations: not all devices/browsers support it; battery saver may override; some mobile browsers release the lock when backgrounded.
helpQA7Q: How does this website collect and store my information?
helpQA7A:
Privacy-first design:

• Local only — All preferences (colors, fonts, layout) are stored in your browser’s localStorage. Nothing is uploaded to any server.
• No accounts — No registration, no login, no personal data collected.
• Analytics — We use Umami, a privacy-focused tool that collects anonymous, aggregated data only (page views, clicks). No cookies, no individual tracking.
• Third parties — Time calibration exchanges timestamps only with api.shijian.online. Website favicon sourced from Magnific. Feedback form hosted on 金山文档.
• Source code — Fully open source on GitHub for verification.
wakeLockUnsupported: Wake Lock not supported on this device
wakeLockDenied: Keep screen on was denied by the system
